items: Khud-ionisation (autoprotolysis): H2SO4 + H2SO4 H3SO4+ + HSO4- ke saath equilibrium mein, K = 2.7 x 10^-4, pani se zyada, to yeh non-aqueous protic solvent ka kaam deta hai. Sulfuric acid strong acid hai, pKa1 = -2: H2SO4 + H2O se H3O+ + HSO4-; magar hydrogensulfate kahin kamzor acid hai, pKa2 = 1.92: HSO4- + H2O H3O+ + SO4 2- ke saath equilibrium mein.

Ghaliz sulfuric acid taqatwar dehydrating agent hai, jo sucrose, starch, lakri aur kaghaz se pani nikal kar carbon, bhaap aur garmi deta hai: C12H22O11(s) + H2SO4(l) se 12C(s) + 11H2O(g) + H2SO4(aq), 'carbon snake' ka muzahira. Yeh ethanol ko halaat ke mutabiq ethene ya ethoxyethane mein bhi dehydrate karta hai: C2H5OH + H2SO4 se C2H4 + H2O + H2SO4.
Hydrogen chloride gas tab banti hai jab sulfuric acid sodium chloride se react karta hai: NaCl(s) + H2SO4(l) se NaHSO4(s) + HCl(g).

Metals se reactions metal, acid ki concentration aur darja hararat par munhasir hain. Electrochemical series mein hydrogen se oopar metals (Fe, Al, Zn, Mn, Ni, Mg) dilute acid se react kar ke hydrogen aur metal sulfates dete hain, Zn + H2SO4(aq) se H2 + Zn2+ + SO4 2-; thande ghaliz acid ke saath woh SO2 chhorte aur sulfates banate hain, Zn + 2H2SO4(l) se SO2 + Zn2+ + SO4 2- + 2H2O (print mein 'Fe2+').

Cu, Ag aur Hg jaise metals garam ghaliz acid se react kar ke sulfates banate hain. Sulfuric acid aam oxidising agent nahi samjha jata kyunke sulfate anion mustahkam aur sirf halka oxidising hai, magar garam ghaliz acid zyada darja hararat, protons ki zyada concentration aur nascent oxygen banne ki wajah se darmiyana taqatwar oxidising agent hai: Cu + 2H2SO4(l) se SO2 + 2H2O + Cu2+ + SO4 2-.

blocks.prompt: Ghaliz H2SO4 ke starch aur oxalic acid ke saath dehydration reactions likhein, aur thande aur garam acid ki oxidising taqat ka muqabla karein (Quick Check 12.7a, c).
blocks.explanation: Starch: (C6H10O5)n + ghaliz H2SO4 se 6nC + 5nH2O, jal kar carbon. Oxalic acid: H2C2O4 ghaliz H2SO4 ke saath CO + CO2 + H2O deta hai, pani ke ajza hataye jate hue. Thanda ghaliz acid sirf kamzor oxidiser hai (sulfate ion mustahkam hai), zyada tar hydrogen se oopar metals se react karta hai; garam ghaliz acid, zyada darja hararat, zyada [H+] aur nascent oxygen ke saath, copper, silver aur mercury ko bhi oxidise karta hai, khud SO2 mein reduce hote hue.

items: Autoprotolysis (K 2.7 x 10^-4, non-aqueous solvent); strong acid pKa1 -2, HSO4- kamzor pKa2 1.92; cheeni (carbon snake) aur ethanol ko dehydrate karta hai; NaCl HCl deta hai; dilute acid + faal metals H2 dete hain, thanda ghaliz SO2, garam ghaliz Cu, Ag, Hg ko SO2 ke saath sulfates mein oxidise karta hai.
